{{Quote|Starkiller's emotions made him weak. You must destroy what he created. And you must learn to hate what he loved.|Darth Vader, to Subject 1138|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
[[Subject 1138]] "Starkiller," a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]] had '''two''' '''lightsabers''' that were created to serve as his weapons. The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were given to the clone by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] during his [[Sith training|training]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and were used during his [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escape attempt]] immediately after Vader deemed Starkiller to be another failure in a long line of [[Aberrant clone|imperfect clones]].

==Specifications==
[[File:Starkiller_Cato_Neimoidia.png|thumb|left|250px|Subject 1138's lightsabers originally contained synthetic crystals, producing crimson blades.]]
[[Subject 1138]]'s dual [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapons]] were constructed for the purpose of [[Sith training|training]] [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="TFU2n" /> They were part of a second series of lightsabers that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] bestowed to the clones who progressed far through their trials.<ref name="TFU2dt">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> As such, these lightsabers each contained a [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic crystal]] which enabled them to produce a [[red]] blade.<ref name="TFU2n" /> Their design was a modified version of the first set of lightsabers,<ref name="TFU2vg" /> many copies of which were used by the [[Aberrant clone|clones]] who were deemed as failures early in their training.<ref name="TFU2db">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

Like their counterpart weapons, Starkiller's lightsabers were both based on a transparent hilt which displayed the blade's energy fluctuating within. The hilts featured a set of [[black]] plates; the activator a simple red button located on a silver ring around the hilt, approximately halfway along its length. The emitters featured a slanted, wrap-around guard that was aesthetically similar to emitter shrouds, rather than the standard emitters on the first stock design.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

As with his clone precursors, Starkiller was programmed with the knowledge and skills of his [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] via [[memory flash]]es. As such, he inherited the original Starkiller's preference for the [[Form V/Legends|Form V/Shien-style]] reverse grip, as well as the [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV/Ataru]] and [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI/Niman]] fighting styles. These combat forms ultimately enabled the clone to master the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] technique, of which Starkiller found both strengths and weaknesses in. On the one hand, he acknowledged that the use of dual-lightsabers increased his overall abilities as a combatant, and on the other, Jar'Kai diminished the strength of his attacks since it prevented him from wielding a lightsaber with both hands.<ref name="TFU2n" />

==History==
{{Quote|Strike her down.''"<br />"''I can't!''"<br />"''You will. You were created to do my bidding.|Darth Vader and Subject 1138|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
[[File:Starkiller_Kamino_Training.png|thumb|right|250px|Subject 1138 "Starkiller" received his lightsabers from Darth Vader, the Sith Lord who trained the original Starkiller.]]
After progressing far through a series of trials, Subject 1138 "Starkiller" received his lightsabers from his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and creator, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader,<ref name="TFU2n" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFU2c" /> One of many clones created and tested to replace the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|original apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], Starkiller's first task with his new weapons was to destroy a group of [[Sith Training Droid|training droids]] disguised as [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]]. Sparing no feelings for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that Starkiller's progenitor helped to forge, the clone destroyed the faux-[[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] with practiced ease, only to find himself incapable of bringing his lightsabers down on a [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] that took on the form of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. The failed training session, combined with the resurfaced memories of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] whom Marek fell in love with, caused Starkiller to turn against his creator by [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaping]] from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], taking his lightsabers with him in the process.<ref name="TFU2n" />

[[File:Galen_dual.png|thumb|left|250px|Starkiller replaced his lightsabers' synthetic crystals, changing the color of the blades to blue.]]
While traveling throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an attempt to locate Eclipse, Starkiller had numerous occasions to use his dual-lightsabers in combat. On [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], the clone killed scores of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and various other types of [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]], shortly before using his lightsabers against [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]'s [[Gorog (creature)|Gorog]].<ref name="TFU2vg" /> Afterward, he altered the color of the blades to blue when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] presented him with two crystals&mdash;relics of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;to replace Starkiller's synthetic ones.<ref name="TFU2n" />

Shortly after their alteration, Starkiller used the lightsabers against a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Terror Trooper]]s and [[Terror Droid]]s that had [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|infiltrated]] the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']], the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] commanded by Captain Eclipse. Upon clearing the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the Terror units, the clone utilized his lightsabers against various Imperial soldiers, including [[Saber Guard]]smen and [[Imperial Sith Acolyte|Sith Acolytes]], during the [[Assault on Kamino]]. In [[Timira City]], the [[Timira City Cloning Facility|cloning facility]] where Starkiller was created, his lightsabers left a massacre in their wake; much of the Imperial garrison was destroyed by the clone as he infiltrated the inner workings of Timira City.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

[[File:EvenClonesHaveDaddyIssues-TFU2Comic.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller's lightsabers were destroyed during his duel with Vader, who was defeated by the clone nonetheless.]]
Before engaging Darth Vader in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], Starkiller was forced to use his lightsabers against a group of aberrant clones, all of whom originated from Galen Marek's genetic material as well. When Vader threatened to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|strangle]] Juno Eclipse to death via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Starkiller discarded his weapons as a gesture of submission. Eclipse discreetly retrieved one of the lightsabers and attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord, damaging the control panel on Vader's [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] in the process. Vader separated the lightsaber from Eclipse with a powerful [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force Push]] in retaliation.<ref name="TFU2n" /> Reclaiming both lightsabers through [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], Starkiller was driven into a state of [[Force Enrage|rage]] by Vader's attack on Eclipse.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> In the final portion of their duel, Vader utilized a Force blast to disarm Starkiller, which completely destroyed both lightsabers. Despite the loss of his weapons, Starkiller manages to subdue Vader with the use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and take [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]].<ref name="TFU2n" /><ref name="TFU2vg" /> Vader was then arrested by Kota's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] while his lightsaber remained in Starkiller's possession.<ref name="TFU2n" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novelization]], which is the most canonically relevant source involving the weapons, both lightsabers are destroyed in the [[Assault on Kamino]] after Vader Force blasts them from Starkiller's hands and they shatter.<ref name="TFU2n" /> In the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|video game]] and [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|graphic novelization]], however, Starkiller's lightsabers are still intact at the end of the battle.<ref name="TFU2vg" /><ref name="TFU2c">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>
